mapper.select: SELECT a.RECORD_ID AS recordId, a.CREATE_TIME AS createTime, a.ANSWER_INFO AS answerInfo, a.QUESTION_ID AS questionId, (SELECT MAX(v.DISPOSE_RESULT) FROM POWERSFP_ADVICE_INFO v WHERE v.EVALUATION_ID = a.RECORD_ID) AS disposeResult, (SELECT MAX(v.DIVISION_NAME) FROM POWERSFP_ADVICE_INFO v WHERE v.EVALUATION_ID = a.RECORD_ID) AS divisionName, (SELECT MAX(v.STATUS) FROM POWERSFP_ADVICE_INFO v WHERE v.EVALUATION_ID = a.RECORD_ID) AS adviceStatus FROM SFP_QUESTION_ANSWER a WHERE a.CREATE_TIME >= #{startDate} AND a.CREATE_TIME < #{endDate} + 1 AND INSTR(a.ANSWER_INFO, '173823541780282343918') > 0 ORDER BY a.CREATE_TIME DESC
